levels.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +1 bonus to your Parry score when facing a single opponent wielding a melee weapon. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +1 damage.

conditional.when: facing a single opponent wielding a melee weapon
on thrusting attacks with a lightsaber

levels.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +2 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +2 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack against that opponent this turn gains a +1 skill bonus.

conditional.when: on thrusting attacks with a lightsaber
on your next attack against that opponent, after a successful Parry

levels.effect: You gain a +3 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +3 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +3 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack gains a +2 skill bonus. You may attempt a Disarming Strike (see Disarming Strike, below) at one less penalty than normal.

conditional.when: on thrusting attacks with a lightsaber
on your next attack, after a successful Parry

levels.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +4 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +4 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack gains a +3 skill bonus. You may attempt a Disarming Strike at no penalty. If your opponent attempts to All-Out Attack, you gain a +1 bonus to your counter-attack.

conditional.when: on thrusting attacks with a lightsaber
on your next attack, after a successful Parry
